  }

flowchart TD
    START["Start Development Task"] --> CHECK_PRIN{"Does task impact Core Principles?"}
    CHECK_PRIN -- "No" --> IMPLEMENT["Implement Feature"]
    CHECK_PRIN -- "Yes" --> VERIFY_GOV["Consult GOV-01: Governance Rules"]
    VERIFY_GOV --> COMPLIANT{"Is implementation compliant?"}
    COMPLIANT -- "Yes" --> IMPLEMENT
    COMPLIANT -- "No" --> AMEND{"Is amendment required?"}
    AMEND -- "Yes" --> AMEND_PROC["Execute Amendment Process (GOV-01)"]
    AMEND_PROC --> VERIFY_GOV
    AMEND -- "No" --> REFACTOR["Refactor to meet Principles"]
    REFACTOR --> COMPLIANT
    IMPLEMENT --> TEST_GATE{"Pass PRIN-03/PRIN-04 Gates?"}
    TEST_GATE -- "No" --> REFACTOR
    TEST_GATE -- "Yes" --> END["Merge to Main"]
